standard.summary: （实验性）Coreset 采样：根据数据点对训练的"难易度"（loss 大小）差异化采样。hard 样本（loss 高）被采样更多次；easy 样本（loss 低）被采样更少次。
standard.effect: coreset_hard_weight 控制高 loss（难样本）的相对采样权重；easy_weight 控制低 loss（易样本）权重。有助于让训练聚焦于模型还未充分学习的样本。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。数据集质量参差不齐（部分样本 loss 持续高）时可以用 coreset 提高对困难样本的关注度。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集很小（<30张）时 loss 统计不稳定，coreset 权重误差大。loss 高的样本不一定是"重要"样本，可能是标注质量差的样本（此时增加采样反而有害）。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) Coreset sampling: samples data points differently according to how hard they are (their loss). Hard samples (high loss) are drawn more often, easy ones (low loss) less often.
standard_en.effect: coreset_hard_weight sets the relative sampling weight of high-loss (hard) samples; easy_weight sets it for low-loss (easy) ones. It helps point training at samples the model has not yet learned well.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Where dataset quality is uneven (some samples keep a high loss), coreset raises attention on the difficult ones.
standard_en.avoidWhen: On a small dataset (<30 images) the loss statistics are unstable and the coreset weights are noisy. And a high-loss sample is not necessarily an important one -- it may just be badly labelled, in which case sampling it more does harm.

advanced.principle: Coreset 维护每个样本的历史 loss EMA，在 DataLoader 采样时按 loss 加权（高 loss → 高权重 → 更频繁采样）。hard_weight/easy_weight 控制高/低 loss 样本的相对采样倍率比。
advanced.tradeoffs: Coreset 改变了数据集的采样分布（不再是均匀 i.i.d.），与标准 ERM（经验风险最小化）有理论偏差。对于小数据集 LoRA，数据多样性比重要性采样更重要。

advanced_en.principle: Coreset keeps a per-sample historical loss EMA and weights DataLoader sampling by loss (high loss → high weight → sampled more often). hard_weight/easy_weight control the relative sampling-rate ratio of high/low-loss samples.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Coreset changes the dataset's sampling distribution (no longer uniform i.i.d.), a theoretical deviation from standard ERM (empirical risk minimization). For small-dataset LoRA, data diversity matters more than importance sampling.
